mapper.select: SELECT id, aggregate_id, payload::text AS payload_json, retry_count FROM tb_outbox_events WHERE event_type = 'COMPLETION_CONFIRMED' AND status = 'PENDING' AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= #{now}) ORDER BY occurred_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_outbox_events SET status = 'PUBLISHED', published_at = #{publishedAt}, next_retry_at = NULL, error_message = NULL WHERE id = #{eventId}
